title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 17. Raises serious concern over the increasing phenomenon of transnational repression, including the suppression of dissenting opinions that do not align with globalist narratives in the European Parliament; stresses the importance of protecting fundamental freedoms and ensuring that responses to such threats remain within the competence of individual Member States;
